economy.operating_gold_per_turn: city surplus adjusted exactly once for the packet gold-upkeep style
economy.capitalization_gold_per_turn: for each city producing Coinage, shield_stock plus current shield surplus

authoritative_observations.city_buildings: owned-city improvements bitvector decoded against PACKET_RULESET_BUILDING with name and upkeep
authoritative_observations.score: non-negative own and opponent PACKET_PLAYER_INFO score, identity, name, and alive state; the protocol's hidden -1 sentinel is normalized to null

policy_boundary.proxy: projects packet and ruleset facts only
policy_boundary.planner: may compare score and capability, but must select only a current legal production or research action
policy_boundary.observability: may aggregate produced, consumed, and net city yields but may not attribute a city yield delta causally to one building

fail_closed: unknown upkeep style keeps operating and effective gold unavailable
missing Coinage shield stock or surplus keeps capitalization and effective gold unavailable
missing building bitvectors produce an empty inventory rather than inferred buildings
missing or negative hidden player scores remain null and do not create score-gap pressure
invariants: Coinage is never relabeled as structural operating income
technology upkeep is never hidden inside a gross science label
building inventory and score tables remain player-authoritative
all strategic actions still pass exact legal-action membership and post-action verification
